stories.title: Sources: Big Ten to bar NFL players from return
stories.summary: The Big Ten is set to pass a rule Tuesday that doesn't allow players to return from the NFL and play for one of its schools, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.

stories.title: Kiffin pushes back on eligibility double standard
stories.summary: Lane Kiffin said that the SEC and Big Ten are using a moralistic double standard by allowing certain players with court orders to play while attempting to ban others.

stories.title: No gimmes: PGA path for LIV pros not promised
stories.summary: PGA Tour CEO/commissioner Brian Rolapp said the tour has no current plan to bring back LIV golfers Bryson DeChambeau, Jon Rahm and Cameron Smith.

stories.title: York pinged fake prostitute 3 times before arrest
stories.summary: 49ers owner Jed York used a pseudonym and responded multiple times to a fictitious ad for a prostitute prior to his arrest in Ohio over the weekend.

stories.title: Mahomes feeling 'great,' on track to start Week 1
stories.summary: Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes said he has felt better and better the more he has practiced this summer and expects to remain on track to start in Week 1.
